mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP by more than 2% in a quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 5% in two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 5% in two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index by more than 0.5% per month for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% per month for 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% per month for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 300,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2% in a quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% in the same period, it signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% in 1 quarter AND UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
